Visual first

At rest the bench is just objects. Hover shows a name. Click brings the thing to your face with its real images and one line. The full story is one more click away.

Six on the bench

Instagram Moodboard (proof board of the running prototype), KWL (reversible Star Belt 001 + Peak Wallet 002 cut to the real outline), YZY Mobile, Spotify Samples, YE ARCHIVE (a card catalog that searches real records), Ye Tour Media.

Where it comes from

"See the thinking" walks from every object to its source on the wall: Moodboard flows, belt and wallet drawings, the sample chopper, the tour contact sheet. Sketches point back down to the finished thing.

The wall now holds

Spotify Map (folded, opens to the real screen), Yeezy Marketing, LA Apparel, Artist Marketing and The Creative Journey as prints, plus references, notes and experiments.

The drawer

A filing system for the rest: software, data and engineering, games, in progress, older work. Real repos linked. Two projects you named had no repo I could find and are stamped "needs link".

Never a puzzle

Index, About, Resume and Contact stay pinned on both halves. Index is a plain searchable list of everything that jumps you to it, wherever it lives.
